## Who Is Alex Carter?

Alex Carter is a senior full-stack web developer based in San Francisco, California, with 7 years of professional experience. He builds immersive 3D e-commerce storefronts, real-time analytics platforms, and AI-powered tools for startups and enterprises. He ships React/Next.js frontends, Node.js backends, and AWS infrastructure for products used by millions of users.

## Projects (Summary)

- Nebula Analytics — Real-time analytics platform with 3D data visualization streaming millions of events per day. Stack: React, WebGL, Node.js.
- Orbit Commerce — Immersive 3D e-commerce where customers rotate and inspect products before purchase; delivered +38% conversion. Stack: Next.js, Three.js, Stripe.
- Pulse Health — Telehealth platform with secure video, live vitals streaming, and AI triage for 50k+ patients. Stack: TypeScript, WebRTC, AWS.
- Vertex Design System — Open-source design system with 60+ components, theming engine, and full accessibility coverage.
- DeepWorks — Collaborative workspace with live multiplayer editing, CRDT sync, and offline-first architecture.
- Lumen AI — AI assistant platform with streaming responses, tool calling, and enterprise-grade security. Stack: Python, OpenAI, FastAPI.
